_comment: Recorded must-have recall per golden fixture. This is a ratchet, not a target: recall may not drop below these figures, and any rise must be recorded here. Regenerate with `scripts/quality/run.sh --runs 1 --update-baseline`.
measured_on_note: BASE commit whose tree these figures were measured against, NOT the commit this file lands in. measured_on is 18748824b — the merge-base of the #6276 branch (fix/6276-django-manager-kind) and main — plus that branch's ONE fix: a record that another record names as its #6104 merge-facet anchor (grafel.twin_of) is no longer an eligible fold SOURCE, in foldClassHierarchyShadows (cmd/grafel/index.go) and its incremental mirror FoldFrameworkClassKinds (internal/engine/classfold.go). It is the mirror of #6275's rule, which had made a facet ineligible as a fold SURVIVOR: the base class node could still be folded into a THIRD, framework-typed record while a facet was anchored on it, which deletes the node the facet names just the same. TWO figures move as a direct result, both on python-django-mini: entity_found 26->29 (SCOPE.Component User, UserListView and UserDetailView all survive the fold now, so the fixture is at 100% must-have entity recall) and relationship_found 8->12. That cleared the LAST known_regressions entry in this file (#6276, entity_found 27->26) and known_regressions is now empty; internal/quality/baseline_test.go's mustAnnotate was emptied in the same change, which is the reviewable half of that act. NO OTHER FIXTURE'S FIGURES MOVED - measured, not assumed, by a full `scripts/quality/run.sh --ratchet --runs 1` over all 26 fixtures before and after the fix: only the two python-django-mini figures were reported as IMPROVED. Every other figure in this file is what 18748824b already produced, with the same two exceptions the paragraphs below record (solidity-mini, vbnet-mini). THE PARAGRAPHS BELOW ARE THE HISTORY OF EARLIER RE-RECORDS and still speak of df7ec16e2 as the measurement base; read them as the provenance of the figures they name, not as a claim about the current measured_on. This field is the merge-base with the default branch, and `--update-baseline` now RECORDS IT THAT WAY ITSELF (#6564): `git_sha()` in scripts/quality/ratchet.py returns `git merge-base HEAD <default branch>`, and the writer REFUSES to write a measured_on that is not an ancestor of that branch. It used to write HEAD at measurement time, and HEAD on a feature branch is not durable: amend or rebase the commit and the recorded sha becomes a sibling that no ref reaches, and a squash-merge kills it for certain. That is not hypothetical — this file has recorded a pre-amend or pre-squash commit of a change editing it THREE TIMES, most recently at PR #6552, and TestBaselineMeasuredOnIsReachable caught it every time; the correction was a hand re-pin that the note asked for and nobody performed. The merge-base is on main, so it stays an ancestor of HEAD before and after the merge. Re-record with --update-baseline and the pin is done for you — there is no manual step afterwards, and hand-editing this field is what the canonicality gate (#6466) exists to stop. SOLIDITY-MINI IS THE EXCEPTION TO THE SENTENCE ABOVE ABOUT EVERY OTHER FIGURE: its four figures were measured at 2872b201a (2026-08-20) by `build/grafel quality --json <report> internal/quality/golden/solidity-mini`, not at df7ec16e2, because the fixture did not exist at df7ec16e2 (#6424). Nothing else in this file moved when it was added -- the fixture is a new directory, so no other fixture's tree changed. IT IS ALSO THE ONE FIXTURE THAT IS DELIBERATELY RED, AND ITS FLOOR IS SUPPOSED TO RISE. 19/40 entities and 8/13 relationships is not a measurement of how hard Solidity is, and it is not the Solidity extractor's recall either: the must-have set deliberately over-samples the broken shapes, so it is the measured cost of the six recall defects in #6423, which expected.json encodes as must-haves ON PURPOSE so that a fix shows up here as a number instead of an assertion. Real extractor recall over that same src/ is 31/52 = 59.6% -- quote that, never 19/40, as a coverage figure. Do not close the gap by deleting a must-have from expected.json -- TestBaselineRecordedCountsAreSane would still pass (the ratchet's own entity_expected check WOULD fail it, ratchet.py:310-316, but that is a re-record prompt rather than a wall). The seventh defect (#6425's phantom `Vault.helper` Yul operation, and the `type`/`abi.encode` CALLS over-fire) is NOT recorded anywhere in this file, because forbidden_relationships hits are unconditionally fatal in ratchet.py and there is no known-gaps channel for precision; see internal/quality/golden/solidity-mini/NOTICE.md, which carries the exact forbidden entries to add when #6425 lands. VBNET-MINI IS A SECOND EXCEPTION TO THE SENTENCE ABOUT EVERY OTHER FIGURE, ON THE SAME TERMS AS SOLIDITY-MINI: its relationship figures were measured at 58b7c4219 plus the #6454 fix, by `grafel quality --json <report> internal/quality/golden/vbnet-mini`, not at df7ec16e2. BOTH relationship figures move together, 29/29 -> 33/33, and the fixture stays at 100% recall. The four new must-haves are ADDITIONS, not amendments: `NativeServer.OpenFile/GetInfo/GetError/GetFrame` in FrameServer.vb now bind to the receiver's DECLARED type, INativeFrameServer, which is declared in the same file. Before #6454 those four sites produced NO CALLS EDGE AT ALL -- internal/vbnet/parenrefs.go's classify answered ParenUnknown for every non-Me qualifier, and a ParenUnknown that is not at statement head is not a call -- so no existing entry needed changing and relationship_found could not have been lower than relationship_expected at any point. The entity figures did NOT move (20/20 before and after), and no other fixture's tree changed: the fix is confined to internal/vbnet/ and internal/extractors/vbnet/, which only vbnet-mini's src/ exercises. READ THE NEW ENTRIES' NOTES BEFORE TREATING THEM AS PRECISE: like the StructPtr.Dispose entry they are NOT overload-precise (#6440); they assert an in-tree CALLS to a member of that name on that type, nothing finer. THE DISPOSITION COST OF #6454 BELONGS BESIDE THESE FIGURES, because the precedent it overturns was judged on it: S7d (With-block receivers) was closed unbuilt in part because 24 new dangling edges would worsen the disposition vector, and #6454 adds about 2,205 of them. Measured on the 302-file corpus by TestCorpusEdgeResolution, before -> after: bug rate 0.0918 -> 0.1666 (+82%), bug-extractor 1,830 -> 3,919, bug-resolver 143 -> 160, external-known 1,020 -> 1,115. The trade is the RATIO, not the sign: S7d's edges resolved at 1/25, #6454's at 780/2,985 = 26%. Most of the new dangling edges name a .NET Framework type, and they are STILL DANGLING: nothing has resolved them and no open work is known to. AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS SENTENCE SAID THEY 'become joinable the day #6337 lands' (#6495). #6337 has landed (8adfe8028) and did not touch a single one of them: its external-synthesis arm, internal/external.vbnetHierarchyExternal, returns early unless relKind is EXTENDS or IMPLEMENTS, so a CALLS edge can never reach it. That forward reference pointed at work that could not have resolved these edges, and there is no successor issue to point at instead - resolving them needs a CALLS-side external target for .NET Framework members, which nobody has filed. Treat the disposition delta above as the standing cost, not a temporary one, until such work exists. State this delta alongside the recall number; do not quote one without the other. VBNET-MINI MOVES AGAIN AT #6440, ON THE SAME TERMS: entity_found/entity_expected 20/20 -> 22/22, measured at 1456968af plus the #6440 fix by `go test -run TestVBNetOverloadIdentity_6440 ./cmd/grafel/`, which drives the same Index() entry point and the same qualityIndexOptions() as `grafel quality`. The two new must-haves are the two StructPtr.Dispose OVERLOADS in Win32Native.vb, which before #6440 were ONE node: graph.EntityID hashes (repo, kind, name, source_file) and declName rendered a member as `<Type>.<member>` with no arity, so the #4406 dedup kept the :58 record, dropped the :79 one and unioned its edges onto the survivor -- silently, that branch has no counter. Both figures move together and the fixture stays at 100%. relationship_found/relationship_expected do NOT move (33/33): the StructPtr.Dispose IMPLEMENTS row was AMENDED, not added -- its from_name is now the discriminated `StructPtr.Dispose()`, because the `Implements IDisposable.Dispose` clause is on the parameterless overload. One forbidden_relationships entry was added (the phantom self-CALLS `Dispose()` -> `Dispose(True)` that the merge minted); forbidden hits are not scored in these four figures but are unconditionally fatal in ratchet.py, and it fires zero times. MEASURED CORPUS EFFECT, because the priority history of #6440 rests on a number that was scoped wrong: running THIS extractor over the 302-file VB corpus, EntityID collisions fall from 279 groups / 364 dropped records to 5 / 5. The residual 5 are not overloads at all -- they are two files each declaring one type name twice, plus that type's members -- which the deliberate bare-name rule for TYPES (declName) accepts and #6440 does not touch. NO OTHER FIXTURE'S TREE CHANGED: the fix is confined to internal/extractors/vbnet/, which only vbnet-mini's src/ exercises, and it is COLLISION-ONLY by construction, so no non-colliding VB member's entity id moves and no fbversion bump is implied.
